# Echoes Daily

> A personal app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac for the things worth remembering. You build a library of Echoes in your own words, and each morning the app picks a short daily list from it. No streaks, no score, no history, no guilt.

- Price: free, every feature. Optional one-time $5.99 "Support Echoes" purchase. No subscription.
- Requires: iOS / iPadOS 18.6 or later, or a Mac with Apple silicon.
- Privacy: no account, no analytics, no tracking. Data stays on your device and in your own iCloud.
- Made by Jeff Peck, independently. Contact: support@echoesdaily.app
